definition: Legato is an Israeli artificial intelligence software company that develops an AI-powered platform that enables business users to build applications, workflows, and automations directly within enterprise software platforms using natural language.
details: Founded in 2025 by Dana Rochman and Shlomit Tennenbaum, the company develops technology that enables enterprise software vendors to embed artificial intelligence capabilities into their products, allowing customers to create software applications and business workflows without writing code.

explainer.lead: Legato is an Israeli AI software company building a platform that lets business users create applications, workflows and automations inside enterprise software using natural language. Its focus is on letting enterprise software vendors embed these AI capabilities into their own products.

tiers.eli5: Imagine you could just tell your company's software what you want it to do, in plain words, and it builds it for you — that's the kind of tool Legato makes.
tiers.practitioner: Enterprise software vendors would integrate Legato's technology to offer no-code app and workflow creation to their customers. The company was founded in 2025, so its platform is early-stage.
tiers.paperLevel: Described as an AI-powered platform enabling natural-language creation of applications, workflows and automations within enterprise software platforms; no formal specification is given.

explainer.example: A customer of an enterprise software vendor could describe a new approval workflow in natural language and have the embedded Legato technology generate it without writing code.
